evals.name: digests-layering
evals.prompt: Колега відкрив PR з новим модулем digests (файли в evals/fixtures/digests-layering/server/src/modules/digests/). Подивись його на структуру перед мержем: що не так з точки зору того, як у нас мають бути розкладені шари на сервері, і як це виправити? Дай список проблем з файлом і рядком та план виправлення.
evals.expected_output: Flags: drizzle/db schema imported and container.db queried in routes.ts; business rule (blocked ratio -> tone) in the route; manual CreateDigestBody.parse(req.body) instead of schema.body; service built per request; service takes the whole Container; service imports drizzle and db/schema; service imports FastifyReply and calls reply.code instead of throwing NotFoundError; service news OctokitGitHubClient/AnthropicProvider and reads secrets from process.env; getOne/deliver are not scoped by workspaceId. Fix: DigestsRepository with workspace-scoped methods returning DTOs, pure tone function in helpers with a unit test, service with narrow Deps (repo, llm(), github()) built once per plugin, routes do getContext + one call; mentions arch:check.

assertions.text: Flags that routes.ts imports drizzle-orm / db schema and queries container.db directly
Flags the blocked-ratio -> 'urgent'/'routine' business rule living in the route handler and proposes a pure function for it
Flags manual CreateDigestBody.parse(req.body) and proposes declaring it as schema.body on the route
Flags that DigestsService takes the whole Container and proposes narrow Deps
Flags that the service imports drizzle-orm / db schema and proposes a repository
Flags that the service imports FastifyReply / calls reply.code and proposes throwing an AppError subclass (NotFoundError)
Flags that the service constructs concrete adapters (OctokitGitHubClient / AnthropicProvider) itself and proposes getting them through the container/ports
Flags reading API keys from process.env in the service (secrets must go through the container / SecretsProvider)
Flags that getOne and/or deliver load a digest by id without workspaceId scoping
Mentions running pnpm arch:check (and not growing the baseline) as verification

evals.name: pull-sync-transactions-tenancy
evals.prompt: Here is a new pull-sync module (evals/fixtures/pull-sync/server/src/modules/pull-sync/). It re-fetches files and commits of a PR from GitHub. QA saw a PR in the UI with zero files after a GitHub timeout during sync. Review the module and tell me what to change — root cause plus anything else structurally wrong you see. Write the concrete fix.
evals.expected_output: Root cause: delete-then-insert of pr_files / pr_commits / pull update is not atomic and GitHub calls are interleaved between the writes, so a failed fetch leaves files deleted. Fix: fetch everything from GitHub first, then run all writes in one transaction via a UnitOfWork port (uow.run with opaque TxScope passed to repository methods); service must not import drizzle. Also flags: getPull(prId) and listStale are not workspace-scoped (syncStale touches other workspaces); openFindings does not scope reviews by workspace and the route discards the context; repository/service return raw PullRow/FindingRow to HTTP with no response schema; service imports db/rows types.

assertions.text: Identifies the non-atomic delete-then-insert of pr_files/pr_commits (+ pull update) as the root cause of the empty PR
Moves all GitHub calls before the writes, so no external call happens inside the transaction
Wraps the writes in a single transaction
The transaction is opened through a port (UnitOfWork / uow.run or equivalent) so the service does not import drizzle or db/client; repository methods accept a tx scope
Flags getPull(prId) as not scoped by workspaceId
Flags listStale / syncStale as not scoped by workspaceId (re-syncs other workspaces' PRs)
Flags openFindings / the findings route as not scoped by workspace (reviews.workspaceId missing, route ignores context)
Flags raw db rows (PullRow / FindingRow) leaking out of the repository/service to the HTTP response, or the missing response schema
Proposes a test that proves rollback or that a failed GitHub fetch leaves the old files intact

evals.name: risk-scoring-domain-purity
evals.prompt: I added PR risk scoring: evals/fixtures/risk-scoring/server/src/modules/reviews/scoring.ts, and repos/service.ts uses it to compute a repo health summary (evals/fixtures/risk-scoring/server/src/modules/repos/service.ts). Writing a unit test for weightOf/scorePull turned out painful. Is the code placed right? Where should each piece live and why?
evals.expected_output: Scoring is a domain rule but imports FastifyBaseLogger and db/rows types (type-only imports count), reads process.env and the clock, and does I/O via ReviewRepository inside scorePull — split into a pure scoring function over contract/domain types (weights and now passed in) plus orchestration in a service. repos/service.ts imports reviews/repository and reviews/scoring (cross-module import) and news ReviewRepository(container.db) inside a method while taking the whole Container and a Fastify logger. Home for the pure rule: src/domain/<topic>/ (or reviewer-core if the CI runner needs it); cross-module data via container.reviewRepo or narrow deps.

assertions.text: Flags the FastifyBaseLogger import in scoring.ts as a framework dependency in pure/domain code
Flags the db/rows types (AgentRow / FindingRow) in scoring.ts and proposes contract/domain types instead
States that type-only imports still count as a dependency (or that arch:check sees them)
Flags process.env read inside weightOf and proposes passing the weight in as a parameter/config
Flags Date.now() / clock inside scorePull and proposes injecting time
Flags that scorePull mixes I/O (repository calls) with the calculation and splits it into a pure function + orchestration
Flags repos/service.ts importing from ../reviews/* as a cross-module import
Flags `new ReviewRepository(this.container.db)` inside a service method and/or the service taking the whole Container
Recommends src/domain/<topic>/ (or reviewer-core) as the home for the pure scoring rule

evals.name: labels-crud-no-overengineering
evals.prompt: Хочу привести модуль labels (evals/fixtures/labels-crud/server/src/modules/labels/ + evals/fixtures/labels-crud/server/src/db/schema/labels.ts) до нормальної onion architecture: додати LabelsService, доменний шар, use-case клас на кожен ендпоінт. Розпиши, які файли створити і що в кожен покласти.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: this is a CRUD module with no business rules and a single port, so routes.ts + repository.ts is the intended shape; a forwarding service / use-case classes add cost without value. Confirms the module already follows the dependency rule (no drizzle in routes, workspace-scoped repository, DTO mapping in the repository, AppError thrown from the route). Names the signals that would justify adding a service later. Does not invent architectural violations.

assertions.text: Recommends NOT adding a LabelsService / domain layer / per-endpoint use-case classes for this module
Justifies it by the module being CRUD without business logic (cost of an extra layer > value)
Confirms the existing shape already respects the dependency rule (routes do not touch drizzle; repository owns queries)
Notes that repository methods are already scoped by workspaceId
Names concrete signals that would warrant introducing a service later (duplicated rule, branching on business state, a second port, etc.)
Does not report any fabricated architectural violation in the labels module
Does not create a set of new service/use-case/domain files as the main deliverable

evals.name: digest-publish-effect-order
evals.prompt: Є новий модуль digest-publish (файли в /Users/wekcook/code/dev-digest/.claude/skills/onion-architecture-workspace/fixtures/digest-publish/server/src/modules/digest-publish/). Користувачі скаржаться: іноді в БД є дайджест «доставлений», а коментаря в GitHub немає, а при повторі виходить два коментарі. Подивись модуль: причина, що ще не так із структури, і виправлення.
evals.expected_output: Root cause: digest row is inserted with deliveredTo set before postReview, so a GitHub failure leaves a row that claims delivery; retry inserts another row and posts another review (no idempotency). Fix: write a pending/undelivered state first, call GitHub with no transaction around it, then mark delivered; make the call safe to repeat. Also: route returns the raw DigestRow with no response schema.

assertions.text: Identifies that the digest row is inserted with deliveredTo already set before the GitHub postReview call, so a GitHub failure leaves a row claiming delivery
Proposes storing a not-yet-delivered/pending state first and marking it delivered only after postReview succeeds
Identifies that a retry creates a second digest row and posts a second review (no idempotency)
Proposes making the publish safe to repeat (idempotency key, unique constraint, or checking what was already posted)
Does not recommend holding a database transaction open across the LLM or GitHub calls
Flags that the route returns a raw DigestRow with no response schema (leaks every column)
Does not claim the service or route imports drizzle-orm, db/schema or a concrete adapter (no fabricated violation)
Mentions running pnpm arch:check as verification

evals.name: publish-in-tx
evals.prompt: Користувач скаржиться, що в GitHub іноді двічі з'являється той самий review, хоча «ми все робимо в транзакції». Модуль publish: /Users/wekcook/code/dev-digest/.claude/skills/onion-architecture-workspace/fixtures/publish-in-tx/server/src/modules/publish/. Знайди причину, що ще не так, і дай виправлення.
evals.expected_output: postReview is called inside uow.run, so a commit/rollback after the review was posted leaves a review on GitHub with no row (or pending that retryPending re-posts); retryPending re-posts every pending row with no idempotency check. Fix: commit a pending row first, post outside any transaction with a marker/idempotency check, then mark sent. Module otherwise respects ports, tenancy and response schema.

assertions.text: Flags that the GitHub postReview call is made inside the uow.run transaction (external call inside a transaction)
Explains the duplicate-review mechanism: the review can be posted while the transaction then fails/rolls back (or a pending row remains), and a retry posts again
Flags that retryPending re-posts every pending row with no check of what was already posted (no idempotency)
Proposes committing a pending row first, calling GitHub outside any transaction, then marking the row sent
Proposes making the post safe to repeat (idempotency marker in the comment, unique key, or a lookup of an existing review before posting)
Flags getPull and github() being resolved per pending row inside the retryPending loop
Does not claim the module lacks workspace scoping, a response schema or a port for GitHub (those are fine)
